TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE
AND PLANS
3039 W. Irving Park Road

The Applicant seeks to rezone 3039 W. Irving Park Road from a B3-1 Community Shopping
District to a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District in order to convert the existing ground-floor
commercial space into two (2) dwelling units. Currently, the subject property is improved witha
two-story mixed-use building with approximately 2,800 square feet of vacant ground-floor
commercial space and two (2) residential dwelling units above. The Applicant seeks to convert
the existing mixed-use building to a multifamily residential building with 4 dwelling units. The

footprint of the existing building will remain unchanged.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks a variation to reduce the required rear
setback from 30 feet to 0 feet under Section 17-13-1101-B and all zoning relief required under the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance necessary for the plans subject to this Zoning Map Amendment.
